evaluation.overall_comment: The core translation demonstrates strong technical accuracy and complete information transfer, making it suitable for a Vietnamese physics-interested audience once cleaned up. With editorial removal of the translator's notes and minor phrasing adjustments to better match natural Vietnamese academic discourse, this would reach a high quality standard.
